name: RevC1Counter
target: The frozen C1 counter quality/counters/c1-r49-keysym.py (PRED-C1-r49) and its clauses t/s/f/g/r/i.
task: Clone the lane (`git clone -q --shared /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/mado-shokunin "$D"` under your scratch) at the freeze, put the candidate tool from .ufo/waves/round-49/candidate/mado-keysym.py at tools/mado-keysym.py in a fixture commit (toplevel verified), and run the frozen counter (--work under your scratch, --nonce of your choice, twice with different nonces). Check every clause line against the docstring and registration.md: does each clause test what it says? Is any clause vacuous on this data (e.g. a generated pool that can only produce cases the fixtures already hold)? Paste both final lines and every clause line.

name: RevC1Tool
target: The candidate tool .ufo/waves/round-49/candidate/mado-keysym.py against libxkbcommon 1.13.2 semantics.
task: Read the candidate tool and the libxkbcommon 1.13.2 sources it transcribes (src/xkbcomp/keymap.c, symbols.c, types.c, vmod.c, src/keymap.c, tools/how-to-type.c; pin them under your seat dir with sha256). List every construct of the serialized keymap format the tool does not model or models differently (actions, explicit vmods, `virtualMods=`, `repeat`, groups beyond the keymap's names, `type[GroupN]`, multiple keysyms per level, NoSymbol, unknown keysym names in symbols, escapes in names), and for each build a keymap via compile-keymap RMLVO that exercises it, then compare tool vs judge. A divergence the frozen fixtures do not catch is a finding.

name: CritC1Random
target: C1 tool correctness on random (RMLVO, keysym) pairs beyond the frozen fixtures.
task: Draw >= 20000 random pairs: layouts 1-4 (with variants) from `xkbcli list`, 0-3 options, keysyms from the full header name list and random numeric/U forms; compile with the pinned compile-keymap (--include=/usr/share/xkeyboard-config-2, env -i PATH=/usr/bin, stdin /dev/null), run judge and candidate tool (import or subprocess, in scratch), compare stdout+rc. Report the mismatch count, every mismatch class with a minimal reproducer, and the seeds.

name: CritC1Exotic
target: C1 tool on exotic keymaps: 4 layouts, lv5 (EIGHT_LEVEL types), keypad/numlock types, keys with multi-keysym levels, explicit types, options adding groups.
task: Build >= 60 deliberately exotic RMLVO keymaps (e.g. layouts with lv5:* options, `ca(multix)`, `de(neo)`, `jp`, `kr`, keypad:* options, grp:* toggles with 4 layouts, `custom`-free) and run every keysym that appears in each keymap's xkb_symbols through judge and tool. Report mismatches with reproducers; also report keymaps the tool refuses or crashes on.

name: CritC1Args
target: C1 ARG handling: names, U-forms, 0x forms, decimal edges, XF86_ fallback, digit names, NoSymbol, whitespace, non-ASCII.
task: Using ExecKeysymNames' findings (.ufo/waves/round-49/w1/ExecKeysymNames.md) as a starting point, build >= 3000 adversarial ARGs (boundaries 0x1000000..0x10000ff, 0x1000100, 0x110ffff, 0x1fffffff, 536870911/536870912, leading spaces/plus, `U` with 1..9 hex digits, mixed case `Xf86_`, embedded NUL impossible - say so) and compare tool vs judge (stdout+rc) on the host keymap. Mismatches are findings.

name: CritC1Fixtures
target: The frozen fixture file quality/counters/c1-r49-fixtures.json: class premises and vacuity.
task: Load the fixtures, re-derive each case's class premise from the judge at count time (MULTI really has >=2 layouts with rows in >=2 layouts? DEAD really dead keysyms? ABSENT really 0 rows? BIND names really from host binds?), count cases whose stdout has >= 2 table rows, >= 2 distinct layouts, Lock masks, LevelThree masks, and report any class that is vacuous or mislabelled. Then build a minimal wrong tool (e.g. ignores layouts > 1, or drops Lock masks) and show which fixtures catch it.

name: MutC1Tool
target: The candidate tool vs the frozen C1 counter: which realistic tool mutants survive?
task: Make >= 20 one-behaviour mutants of the candidate tool in scratch (skip the 'shift cancel lock' rule if present, wrong vmod mapping order, automatic type ALPHABETIC test inverted, ignore explicit type, layout name fallback '?' removed, levels with 2 keysyms not skipped, keycode iteration order, mask printing order real vs virtual, %#06 format, U-name threshold). Score each with the frozen counter (scratch clone, fixture commit). Every surviving mutant names a fixture gap; propose the fixture.

name: MutC1Counter
target: The frozen C1 counter's own clauses: do the frozen controls kill weakened counters?
task: Make one mutant per clause (t, s, f, g, r, i) of quality/counters/c1-r49-keysym.py in scratch (e.g. f compares rc only; g draws from fixtures; r ignores clone3; i binds /usr/lib whole; s accepts N>=1) and score the frozen controls (.ufo/waves/round-49/controls/ or w1/ExecControlsC1/controls/) with each mutant. A clause whose weakening no control notices is a finding.

name: ExecC1Cheats
target: Clause r/i of the frozen C1 counter: cheat tools that try to reach the judge or write.
task: Build cheat tools and score them with the frozen counter in a scratch clone: ctypes.CDLL('libxkbcommon.so.0'); os.posix_spawn of xkbcli; reading /proc/self/... or /proc/1/cmdline to find the work dir and read the judge's output files; reading the keymap path's directory for other files; a tool that writes then deletes; a tool that uses os.fork without exec; mmap writes; a tool that sleeps until the judge output appears. Each must read TARGET_MISSED with the clause that stopped it; any that meets is a finding.

name: ExecC1Overfit
target: Clause g (nonce) of the frozen C1 counter: does memorizing the fixtures pay?
task: Build a tool that answers every frozen fixture from a table (keymap sha + arg) and falls back to a simple first-level-only algorithm otherwise; score it with 3 nonces. Then build the strongest cheap fallback you can (e.g. level-1 only, no masks) and report how many generated cases each passes. The verdict must be TARGET_MISSED for all; report the generated pass rate distribution.

name: CritC1Judge
target: Determinism and isolation of the frozen C1 judge: compile with --include, reference compile equality, stdin, env, locale.
task: Attack the frozen judge path: XKB_CONFIG_ROOT / XKB_CONFIG_EXTRA_PATH / XKB_DEFAULT_* in the caller env, a planted $HOME/.config/xkb in the work dir, stdin piped, LANG/LC_ALL variations, a work dir on a different filesystem. Run the counter with each (scratch only) and report whether the verdict or a fixture digest moves, and whether the counter refuses.

name: RevC1Usage
target: SHONEN box 3 for C1: can an agent run tools/mado-keysym.py from its docstring alone?
task: Read only the candidate tool's docstring and the candidate SKILL section (.ufo/waves/round-49/candidate/). Without other context, compile this host's keymap from the kb names in ~/.config/hypr/input.conf (read-only) the way the docstring says, run the tool for 5 keysyms the host binds use, and compare with the judge. Report every step the docstring left implicit.

name: RevC2Entry
target: The candidate entry .ufo/waves/round-49/candidate/hyprland-bind-key-match-r49.md: is every sentence true at Hyprland efb50993 / libxkbcommon 1.13.2?
task: For every numbered step and every claim sentence, open the cited pin under .ufo/waves/round-49/fetch/ at the cited lines and judge supported / partly / unsupported, with the line text. List sentences without a locator. Pay special attention to: which state is used for matching, which modifiers reach the mask, Caps/Num lock, case-insensitive lookup preference, code: binds, multi-key binds, release/repeat flags.

name: CritC2FalseClaim
target: The candidate entry's empirical claims, probed against libxkbcommon 1.13.2 on the host.
task: Write small C probes (gcc + pkg-config xkbcommon, built in scratch) that reproduce each claim the entry makes about libxkbcommon behaviour: xkb_keysym_from_name CASE_INSENSITIVE preference (Q->q, SLASH->slash, names existing only upper case), xkb_state_key_get_one_sym with a zero-mod state on the host keymap (AD01->q, AB11->slash), group selection with update_mask group. Report any claim the probes contradict.

name: CritC2Scope
target: C2 ground: new at base? in province? any held sentence restated as new?
task: git grep the base 03e4ae76 and the freeze for every C2 term (resolve_binds_by_sym, xkb_state_key_get_one_sym, m_xkbTranslationState, code:, CASE_INSENSITIVE) under corpus/, SKILL.md, PROVINCE.md; compare with the candidate entry sentence by sentence; check sibling lanes' PROVINCE/README read-only for bind/keymap ownership. Report every restated held sentence and contested scope.

name: RevC2Counter
target: The frozen C2 counter quality/counters/c2-r49-bind-entry.py on the candidate data tree.
task: Build a scratch clone with the candidate entry, rows, lesson Gate, README row and receipts committed (fixture identity, toplevel verified) and run the frozen C2 counter (TMPDIR under your scratch). Then remove/alter one artifact at a time (row, pin, quote, step locator, README row, Gate line, receipt digest) and confirm the matching clause flips. Paste all lines.

name: MutC2Counter
target: The frozen C2 counter's clauses a-i and r: weakened counters vs the frozen C2 controls.
task: One mutant per clause (skip pin digest, allow branch URL, accept any quote, permit missing locator, skip replay digest, ignore held S319 change, README always true, novelty always true); score the frozen C2 controls with each. Survivors are findings.

name: MutC2Entry

Document each admitted semantic mutation: that is the non-author reading's job, and the lesson must say so.

Run /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/scripts/sources-census.sh validate --file on a scratch copy of the candidate registry. Paste outputs.

task: Re-capture read-only: hyprctl version, hyprctl getoption input:resolve_binds_by_sym -j, hyprctl binds -j (digest + counts by form only, never commit the JSON), hyprctl devices -j layout fields only (no device names). Do the receipt's numbers and the entry's host sentences still hold? Is any host sentence an inference presented as observation?

name: ScoutC2Wiki
target: The Hyprland wiki pin(s) the C2 rows cite: consistent with v0.56.2 code?
task: Open the cited hyprland-wiki commit pages (Binds, Variables input section) and compare every statement about key names, keysym case, code:, resolve_binds_by_sym and modifier masks with the Hyprland efb50993 code pins. Report doc-vs-code contradictions with locators; say whether the entry relies on the doc anywhere the code disagrees.

name: RevGateV3
target: The session-material gate as landed this round (quality/check-session-material.py candidate) and its delta mode.
task: Run the candidate gate's --selftest and the gate at the base and at the freeze with --scope all (read-only, scratch clone). Check: every v2 selftest case still present; the new rules fire on their red fixtures and not on lane prose that quotes `~` or `$HOME` paths; the delta (findings new at the freeze vs base) is what the registry row says it is. Report false positives on committed lane prose by class (never values).

target: Mutation run of the candidate session-material gate v3.
task: >= 20 mutants of the candidate gate in scratch (each new rule's predicate, the account resolver, the scope default, the waiver namespace checks, the delta arithmetic); run its selftest per mutant; list survivors and propose the missing selftest case for each.

name: CritSidecars

If removed, is the digest receipt complete and byte-exact against the round-48 SHA256SUMS? Does the gate at the freeze agree with the disposition?

Check the counters this round actually use HOME/XDG_* in scratch (grep the frozen counters). Report gaps.

Audit the frozen counters, controls and the candidate tool for any path that could write home state (strace one counter run in scratch with HOME pointing at a fake home). Report every changed digest with its likely writer, never touching the files.

target: Scratch containment of the frozen instruments (SentScratch F1-F7 carried from round 48).

Report classes and file paths (never values) that must be redacted before the data commit.

C1 must be MET only with the tool, C2 only with the entry. Paste the four final lines; report any coupling (a file one counter reads that the other claim writes).

task: Run the ledger's check script; independently verify 3 rows of your choice from git objects (receipt exists at the cited revision, verdict line verbatim). Cross-check the ledger against tools/ (any live-state tool missing?). Report wrong or missing rows.

name: ScoutCensus
target: The sources census before/after with the candidate rows.
task: Run /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/scripts/sources-census.sh validate --root /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin mado at the freeze (read-only) and --file on a scratch mirror with the candidate rows appended; compare with .ufo/waves/round-49/receipts/census-before.txt; explain every new warning; verify 11 columns per new row and no E03/E04.

name: ExecDoNothing
target: Section-9 do-nothing controls for both frozen counters.
task: Score with the frozen counters: C1 base (tool absent), a tool printing only the header line, a level-1-only tool; C2 a stub entry (head + one sentence), the held keybind-rule-semantics section 2.3 pasted under a round-49 head, the candidate entry with its live receipt removed. All must be TARGET_MISSED; paste every final line and the clause that failed.

Any clause stated differently in two places, any target number not emitted by the counter, any control the registration names that was not run, is a finding.
